prompts.name: ultima-neck-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE replacement cutout game sprite part matching the supplied Ultima Weapon pixel-art rig sheet. Output ONLY the HEAD AND COMPLETE NECK as one connected piece, no torso, no wings, no other parts. Match the source's intricate black metallic scales, silver sharp armour, deep red accents, ember-orange eye, same three-quarter view facing screen-right and horns swept toward screen-left. CRITICAL anatomical correction: the long vertical red-and-black area BELOW the skull is a NECK, NOT an open mouth. Give it overlapping silver/black cervical armour plates and red seams. NO teeth and NO jaw opening anywhere down the throat/neck. A tiny CLOSED beak-like mouth sits directly under the eye at the upper right of the skull. Neck extends fully downwards to a broad smooth rounded dark insertion tab, suitable for being hidden inside the torso collar. Preserve a small fierce skull and tall curved neck rather than a huge screaming mouth. Pixel-art high-detail JRPG boss sprite, hard clustered pixel edges, no blurry painting, no text. Center one complete head-neck unit with padding on a genuinely transparent background. Keep the top-left illumination and black/silver/red palette of the reference.

prompts.name: bahamut-neck-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE replacement head-and-neck cutout for the golden Bahamut sprite shown in the supplied reference sheet. Match exactly the gold scale colour, crisp detailed retro JRPG pixel-art rendering, highlights from top-left. Output ONLY ONE complete connected SMALL DRAGON HEAD AND LONG CONTINUOUS NECK; no wings/body/arms. Head tilted up towards the upper-left, classic roaring at the sky, narrow long dragon snout, swept back horns, jaw opens upward; the open mouth ends at the real jaw under the skull, then a continuous curved scaled neck descends. The skull must be SMALL relative to the neck (head width about 45% of neck-and-head combined height). Avoid a big bobble head. Neck has dense golden scales, dark-gold underside, layered neck spines, and a substantial gently tapered base extension painted all the way to its bottom, with no black severed hole, so it can overlap BEHIND the body collar. Keep the long neck flowing naturally into chest orientation of the supplied torso (frontal three-quarter body, small head tilted up and slightly left). Transparent background with ample padding; no other pieces, no labels, no floor.

prompts.name: alexander-arms-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a corrected transparent rig-parts sheet for the two COMPLETE ARMS of Perfect Alexander from the supplied reference. Match this exact detailed pixel-art style, black steel armour with bright gold trim, cream reflected metal, luminous amber palm. TWO separate fully painted components with wide transparent gap, one on LEFT HALF and one on RIGHT HALF, no overlap, no labels. LEFT component: screen-left arm, starting at UPPER RIGHT with a fully painted circular dark shoulder insertion joint, castle-turret pauldron above it; short thick upper arm descends diagonally toward lower left, natural elbow, then foreshortened forearm terminating in a large anatomically coherent CLOSED MECHANICAL FIST pointing toward viewer-left. RIGHT component: screen-right arm, starting at UPPER LEFT with complete shoulder insertion joint and castle turret pauldron; upper arm descends to an elbow then forearm reaches toward the lower right and the viewer, ending in a very large OPEN PALM with ONE thumb and FOUR articulated fingers and a circular gold-white light in the centre. Maintain continuous shoulder -> upper arm -> elbow -> forearm -> wrist -> hand anatomy. Render all hidden joint surface at arm root for overlap behind torso. No detached floating hands, no extra hands, no body, no wings, no halos. Each component has a round insertion shoulder painted in shadow rather than an empty hole. Transparent background without glow haze, hard crisp pixel clusters like a polished JRPG boss sprite. Keep entire fingers within canvas, generous padding.

prompts.name: thordan-arm-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE corrected COMPLETE sword-arm cutout matching the screen-right sword arm of the supplied Thordan boss rig. Same elaborate silver-white dragonbone armour, black steel recesses, icy blue blade and vivid small orange dragon-eye shoulder motif. Component layout: shoulder and insertion root at the UPPER RIGHT; dragon-head pauldron at upper right/upper middle; a clearly connected upper arm bends down to a naturally placed elbow at middle right, the armoured forearm points down-left toward a HAND centred in the image; a coherent five-finger silver GAUNTLET firmly wraps around the sword GRIP. A narrow grip emerges behind the fist; the STAR-SHAPED GUARD lies immediately toward lower-left from the fist; a LONG BROAD ICE-BLUE SWORD extends diagonally from the guard toward the LOWER LEFT corner. Critical: hand actually closes around the handle, not the blade; wrist flows from forearm; hand is not floating, duplicated or pointed the wrong way; shoulder has a generous fully painted insertion tab that can be hidden beneath body armour. Whole shoulder+arm+hand+sword is ONE continuous piece. No torso, no extra sword, no wings, no text. Match the reference pixel art, lighting from upper left, fine silver filigree. Truly transparent background, NO bloom cloud or glow halo. Leave generous transparent margins at all sides, full sword tip visible.

prompts.name: thordan-arm-v3
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this transparent pixel-art sword arm. Keep the full sword, grip, hand, wrist, elbow, silver armour and orange dragon shoulder EXACTLY in their current pose, scale and positions. ONLY correct the shoulder attachment direction: REMOVE the short cylindrical exposed stump that currently sticks out of the UPPER RIGHT edge behind the shoulder. Extend a small fully painted dark silver shoulder insertion tab from the UPPER LEFT/back side of the dragon-head pauldron instead, pointing LEFT toward where a torso would stand. The torso will be to screen-left of this arm, so the attachment must connect to the LEFT, while the elbow and fist keep the existing down-left sword-swing pose. Do not add a torso, change the hand or sword, mirror the artwork, or make an empty ring. Keep genuine transparent background and the same canvas/padding, no glow haze.

prompts.name: thordan-standing-arm-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE complete corrected sword arm cutout for the SCREEN-LEFT arm (character's RIGHT arm) of the supplied Thordan pixel-art rig. Match the dense polished silver-white skeletal dragon armour, navy-black recesses, orange dragon-eye pauldron, icy blue sword and hard crisp pixel clusters. The old reference's vertical sword looks detached from the fist: REPAIR THIS ANATOMY. Composition: shoulder dragon-head pauldron at UPPER RIGHT; a short fully painted insertion tab extends RIGHT toward the torso. Upper arm descends to elbow at MID-RIGHT. Forearm then bends diagonally LEFT, reaching a GAUNTLET FIST at MID-LEFT. The hand must visibly WRAP AROUND THE SWORD HANDLE at mid-left: show thumb and curled fingers gripping it, grip sticking upward above the fist. Star-shaped guard with a red gem lies just BELOW the fist. Long broad ice-blue sword blade descends VERTICALLY from that guard all the way toward LOWER LEFT, its tip fully inside frame. Thus shoulder->upper arm->elbow->forearm->wrist->gripping hand->hilt->guard->blade are one continuous unbroken connected silhouette. Do not put a dangling hand beside a disconnected sword. Do not hold the blade. No torso, wings, extra hands or second sword. The arm and sword must remain a single isolated part with transparent background, no haze, no labels, no ground. Whole complete limb including overlap surface at shoulder. Leave padding. Keep same three-quarter viewpoint and upper-left lighting as the reference.
